description: Invite people to the project by email, as Invite User on the Users page does: each joins the project's members team and is sent an email, in the name of the person signed in, inviting them to accept. An address in the project already, invited or a member, is not invited again: a second identical call sends no email. Up to 25 addresses a call. Someone invited is paged only once they join; add_to_on_call_policy adds them to a policy by their address before that. Acts as the person signed in (OAuth), with their permissions; an API key cannot.
name: invite_people
title: Invite People
